newsitem.title: USA: BioGenex says Ventana unit ordered to pay.
newsitem.headline: BioGenex says Ventana unit ordered to pay.

text.p: BioGenex Laboratories, a supplier of cancer diagnostic and research products, said that BioTek Solutions Inc was ordered to pay punitive damages for infringing BioGenex's patent on the "Antigen Retrieval" procedure for treating tissue specimens.
The U.S. District Court in San Jose, Calif., ordered BioTek, a subsidiary of Ventana Medical Systems Inc to pay punitive damages of $303,112.50, BioGenex said.
The total award, including compensatory damages and interest, is about $850,000, BioGenex said.
The court also ordered a permanent injunction restraining BioTek from using or promoting the use of the patented method with its products.
Ventana was not immediately available for comment.

The Antigen Retrieval tissue treatment utilizes microwave heating to improve the staining of tissue by antibodies, which is used to analyze tissues such as surgical biopsy specimens to identify tumors and infectious diseases.
